visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair wearing a grey shirt stands in an indoor home environment. She smiles broadly, revealing her teeth, and points her index finger upwards while looking directly at the camera. Behind her on a white shelf is a white house-shaped toy with a yellow interior and a warm light glowing from within. (2) The shot transitions to a close-up of the house-shaped toy. A My Melody figurine sits inside the illuminated center, while a Brown character in a green dinosaur suit stands next to it. A red toy fire truck is positioned on the left side of the frame. The lighting is focused and bright on the objects. (3) A young baby with very little hair, wearing a light tan onesie, is seen crawling on a colorful patterned play mat towards the toy house. The background shows a living room with a mirror reflecting a person sitting at a table. (4) The camera cuts back to the woman who is now holding a small yellow shark figurine. She looks into the camera and speaks expressively with active hand gestures. More figurines are visible on the shelf behind her. (5) A hand enters the frame and places a pink My Melody figurine into the house-shaped device. Another hand then turns a white chimney-like knob on top of the house. (6) A screen recording of a mobile application interface is shown, displaying various colorful character icons like My Melody and Snoopy, along with lists of stories and songs in Traditional Chinese text. (7) The baby is seen sitting on the floor, picking up and examining different figurines including a yellow shark and a pink rabbit. The baby attempts to place a figurine into the toy house while looking closely at the device.
